This level is right for you if you have never danced Bachata ever in your life! Or if you would like to brush up on your basics. In this level we will cover the basic principles of Bachata Dancing such as Basic Body Movement, Timing, Foot-Work, Foot-Placements, and Turns. This level is for anyone who can readily demonstrate/dance everything covered in our Beginner-Level Or anyone who’s completed our ‘Level 1’ material. In this level we will cover how to string basic patterns together, introduce Basic Shine Foot-Work and Body Mechanics for Lead/Follow (Partnering). The goal is to teach you how to be a Smooth Dancer.

You’ve got the fundamentals—now it’s time to refine, connect, and express. In Level 3, we focus on fluid transitions, musical interpretation, and deepening your partner connection. We’ll also explore musicality—how to listen, respond, and dance *with* the music, not just to it. This level is where dancers start turning heads and building confidence on any social floor.

events.description:
Come and enjoy learning West Coast Swing in downtown San Mateo! This is a popular form of swing dancing that has spread around the world.

One of the greatest things about west coast swing is that the dance is highly personalized. Although it is a ‘lead and follow’ partner dance with the follower traveling up and down the slot, it allows for a vast amount of freedom, expression and individuality.

**EVERY MONDAY:**

8pm - 9pm West Coast Swing Intermediate Level Class

**Beginner West Coast Swing** is a class designed for students new to the dance. It will be focused on getting the basic rhythms and foundational patterns (left side pass, underarm turn, and sugar push) of the dance.

**West Coast Swing Technique:** If you’ve been craving to feel a stronger connection, cleaner footwork, and richer musicality this class is your next step! We’ll break things down, build them up, and take your west coast swing to the next level-let’s dive deep and grow together!
**\*Pre-requisite: Our WCS Technique class is for Intermediate Level or higher level students.** This is the perfect class to improve your fundamentals and build confidence and flow.

**Intermediate West Coast Swing** is a class designed for students who feel comfortable in their basics, but want to expand their knowledge. This class will focus on lots of basic variations and foundational whip technique and variations. This class will get you comfortable with both 6-count, 8-count patterns, and basic extensions.
